quiet_window: Concurrent automated builds, WSL media checks and heavy tests were paused during measurement. Other portfolio work was limited to text edits and read-only status checks.
uncontrolled_conditions: Ordinary Windows desktop applications and background services
Power management, CPU/GPU frequency and thermal behavior
The integrated GPU and CPU share host resources
Dataset sizes and predicates were evaluated in a fixed order
cpu_baseline_scope: Specialized compiled single-thread loop over the same PSObject properties and valid integer schema, without preprojection. It does not implement general predicate translation or validation.
outlier_policy: Retain every measured observation; report descriptive summaries only.
historical_study: The separate 110-observation June 2026 study was not modified or pooled with this capture.
